# 2 bedroom terraced house for sale

> IDEAL STARTER HOME - MID TERRACE HOUSE - TWO DOUBLE BEDS - EDGE OF TOWN CENTRE LOCATION - BROOKFIELD SCHOOL CATCHMENT Occupying a generous plot is this well proportioned mid terrace home offering 1051 sq. ft. of neutrally presented accommodation. The property features two good sized reception rooms, a useful cellar, and a galley style kitchen with some integrated appliances.
